settings.question: How fast do orders ship?
settings.answer:
Orders process within 24–48 hours and typically ship the next business day (no weekend/holiday ship). Peak periods may take 48–72 hours.

Expedited orders must be placed before 12 PM Eastern to ship same business day; after 12 PM or on weekends, next business day.

Free shipping on Continental US orders over $150. Under $150: $9.95 flat rate. Expedited & overnight available at checkout.

settings.question: Can I track my order?
settings.answer:
Yes — use the tracking link in your shipping email, or log into your customer account for order history and status.

Still stuck? Contact us with your order number.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer:
We ship worldwide (including Canada, UK, and Australia where available). Confirm ship-to countries at checkout.

Customers are responsible for duties, taxes, and customs fees — and for international return shipping when applicable.

settings.question: My tracking says delivered but I don’t have the package
settings.answer:
Once tracking shows delivered to your address, the order is considered fulfilled. Check with neighbors, building staff, or a shared mail area first — especially in apartments or multi-unit buildings.

Questions? Contact us and we’ll help you sort next steps.

settings.question: What’s the difference between Closed Sole and Open Sole?
settings.answer:
Closed Sole: Heel and foot fully covered.

Open Sole: Heel exposed, mid-foot breathing hole. More grounded, barefoot feel. Natural toe splay.

Both perform identically — same grip, same stability, same studio uses. Choice is preference and feel only. Same patented 360° grip, same $74.

settings.question: Why are Barreletics better than grip socks?
settings.answer:
Grip socks have two failure points: silicone/latex dots that peel, and fabric that slips on your foot. Performance Skins use full-bottom structured grip — locked-in through holds, transitions, and balance. No sliding. No resets.

  • Sweat-resistant — stays fresh through intense sessions
  • Latex- and silicone-free
  • Natural toe splay for balance and control
  • Second-skin fit — no stretching out every few weeks

One pair. No more socks.

settings.question: Will these hold on reformer, Cadillac, Megaformer, Lagree, and barre?
settings.answer:
Yes. Built for barre, Classical and reformer Pilates, Cadillac / trapeze table, Chair, Tower, Megaformer, Lagree, yoga, hot yoga, and hot Pilates.

Full-contact grip — not silicone dots. For heated rooms, wear a thin sock or liner under the Skin to absorb sweat; the Skin stays the traction layer.

settings.question: Are they latex- and silicone-free? Hygienic?
settings.answer: Yes. No latex, no silicone. Antimicrobial, sweat-resistant material that doesn’t hold moisture or bacteria the way fabric grip socks do — cleaner on shared reformer carriages and Megaformers. Made in USA. Trusted by 1,000’s of instructors and studios.

settings.question: Can I wear them barefoot or with a thin sock? (Hot Pilates)
settings.answer:
Either works. Many prefer the barefoot feel. Others use a thin toeless or individual-toe sock for warmth or moisture. Skip thick or full-toe socks — they reduce natural toe splay.

Hot Pilates / heated rooms: a thin full sock or liner under the Skin absorbs sweat; grip and performance stay with the Skin.

Studio requires socks? Thin individual-toe or thin full sock underneath keeps you compliant while outperforming grip socks alone.

settings.question: Will they grip on carpet, studio floors, and wet surfaces?
settings.answer:
Studio surfaces — exceptional: hardwood, rubber, vinyl, carpet, reformer carriages, Megaformers, yoga mats.

Inherently slippery surfaces — no footwear wins: wet polished marble, certain wet tile and stone areas, oiled/waxed floors. Exercise caution — Barreletics outperform bare feet in most cases, but they can’t invent traction where the surface has none.

settings.question: Can I wear them outdoors, at the beach, or on a boat?
settings.answer:
Closed Sole especially works beyond the studio — beach, paddleboarding, boat decks, hot sand, resortwear, outdoor yoga — grip and ground feel without shoe bulk. Not a replacement for heavy-duty footwear in extreme conditions.

Same caution on inherently slippery wet tile and stone applies outdoors.

settings.question: What size should I order?
settings.answer:
Start with your regular shoe size. Performance Skins fit like sock sizing:

  • M — Women’s 5.5–7.5 (Kids 2–5)
  • L — Women’s 7.5–11 · Men’s up to 10.5

M and L ship today. Between 7.5 and 8? Wider foot → Large. Narrower → Medium. Between sizes? Most studio practitioners size up for comfort.

Open the size chart →

settings.question: They feel too tight or causing toe pressure
settings.answer:
Usually means size up one. A size exchange is often faster than a refund — start at the returns portal or Contact us.

Dark Grey, Hot Coral, Dark Shadow, and Blue run snugger than Light Grey / Black (more forgiving).

settings.question: They feel too loose or shift during movement
settings.answer:
Usually means size down. If you’re already in the smallest size, a thin toeless or individual-toe sock underneath fine-tunes fit while keeping grip.

Ordered Light Grey and it’s loose? Try Dark Grey, Hot Coral, or Blue for a snugger natural fit — or exchange via the returns portal.

settings.question: I have narrower feet
settings.answer:
Many narrow-footed customers wear a thin toeless or individual-toe sock underneath for security. Or choose Dark Grey, Hot Coral, or Blue — they fit slightly tighter than Light Grey.

Not sure? Contact us for a personal recommendation before you order.

settings.question: How do I put them on?
settings.answer: Pull from the top of the foot — not the straps. Pulling the straps stresses the material and shortens lifespan.

settings.question: How do I clean Performance Skins?
settings.answer:
After class: when you wipe equipment, give the Skins a quick wipe with the same cloth — takes seconds.

Regular clean: warm soapy water, rinse thoroughly, air dry. Never machine wash or bleach. Ready for the next class in under an hour.

settings.question: How long do they last?
settings.answer:
Built in the USA. Many report 18+ months; some wear the same pair 6+ days/week for 3+ years with zero issues. Never loses shape. Never loses grip. Same performance on class 1 as on class 1,000 when cared for.

One pair replaces 6–8 pairs of traditional grip socks per year (illustrative sock-cost ranges).

settings.question: What’s your return and warranty policy?
settings.answer:
30-day returns on items in new, sellable condition — try them on for fit. This is not a studio trial and not “try them in class for 30 days.”

90-day warranty against manufacturing defects only — not normal wear or grip-surface wear from use.

Free shipping on orders over $150. Full language, return shipping, and exchanges on the Shipping & returns page.

settings.question: How do I start a return or exchange?
settings.answer:
Use the returns portal within 30 days of delivery — choose Refund or Exchange. Or Contact us with your order number.

Size exchanges are often the fastest path when fit is the only issue — we ship your exchange at no cost once we receive and inspect the return.

settings.question: Can I exchange for a different size instead of returning?
settings.answer:
Yes — size exchanges are often faster than a refund. Use the returns portal within 30 days of delivery and select Exchange. We ship your exchange at no cost once we receive and inspect the return.

Full steps → Shipping & returns.
